summary.headline: Astrological Chapters 171–201
summary.text: Catalog of chapters 171–201 in an Angelican astrological codex, covering lunar and solar eclipses, zodiacal ascensions, Egyptian terms, times of life, monomoiria, quadrants, lunar nodes, horoscopes, planetary declarations, configurations, and judgments of persons. Cross-references cite the Venetian and Vindobon manuscripts.
